title: 平橋遠水（1985.370）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1985.370）
medium: handscroll; ink and light color on paper
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1570」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: handscroll; ink and light color on paper
The Kelvin Smith Collection, given by Mrs. Kelvin Smith

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → ming；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Reproduced: cat. no. 186, p. 239）
Suzuki, Kei 鈴木敬. Chūgoku kaiga sōgō zuroku [中國繪畫總合圖錄 = Comprehensive Illustrated Catalog of Chinese Paintings]. Tōkyō: Tōkyō Daigaku Shuppankai, 1982.（Reproduced: #A22-093）
Lee, Sherman E. “A. Kelvin Smith (1899-1984): Collector.” The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art 75, no. 7 (September 1988): 240–243.（Mentioned and Reproduced: pp. 242–243）

dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。
款识原文未经本库目验；馆方亦未说明其对该款识真伪的判断。

colophons.text:
隆慶庚午秋仿趙文敏筆. 五峰文伯仁
[印] 五峰山人; 文伯仁印

馆方英译：Artist's inscription, signature, two seals upper end corner:  Imitating Zhao Wenmin's [Zhao Mengfu] brush in autumn, the gengwu year of the Longqing era [1570]. Wufeng, Wen Boren [seals] Wufen shan ren; Wen Boren yin.
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。

provenance.text: (Cheng Qi 程琦 [1911–1988], Tokyo, Japan, sold to Mr. and Mrs. Kelvin Smith)
The Kelvin Smith Collection, Cleveland, OH, given by Mrs. Kelvin [Eleanor Armstrong] Smith [1899–1998] to the Cleveland Museum of Art
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH
